# incident_escalation_path_beta (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about an existing escalation path by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an escalation path by name
data "incident_escalation_path_beta" "urgent_support" {
  name = "Urgent support"
}

# Look up an escalation path by ID
data "incident_escalation_path_beta" "urgent_support" {
  id = "01G0J1EXE7AXZ2C93K61WBPYEH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this escalation path.
- `name` (String) The name of this escalation path, for the user's reference.

### Read-Only

- `repeat_config` (Attributes) Controls if an escalation will repeat after acknowledgement, when the alert is unresolved. When configured, it will repeat after the specified delay. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repeat_config))
- `sequences` (Map of Object) Named sequences of nodes, keyed by a name you choose. Each sequence either ends with a `branch` node or runs off the end of the escalation path. Branches reference other sequences by key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences))
- `start` (String) The key of the sequence this escalation path begins with.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the teams that own this escalation path.
- `working_hours` (List of Object) The working hours for this escalation path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--working_hours))

<a id="nestedatt--repeat_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repeat_config`

Read-Only:

- `delay_repeat_on_activity` (Boolean) Whether to delay the repeat on escalation activity
- `repeat_after_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds after which the escalation repeats

<a id="nestedatt--sequences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences`

Read-Only:

- `nodes` (List of Object) The nodes in this sequence, in the order they run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes`

Read-Only:

- `branch` (Attributes) Send the escalation down one of two sequences, depending on what `if` tests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch))
- `delay` (Attributes) Pause the escalation for a configured duration before advancing to the next node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--delay))
- `escalation_path` (Attributes) Reassign the escalation to another escalation path, continuing from that path's first node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--escalation_path))
- `id` (String) An id for this node, unique within the escalation path, so a `loop` can name it.
- `level` (Attributes) A set of targets (users or schedules) that should be paged, either all at once, or with a round-robin configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--level))
- `loop` (Attributes) Go back to an earlier node and run from there again. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--loop))
- `notify_channel` (Attributes) Send the escalation to a Slack or Microsoft Teams channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--notify_channel))

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.branch`

Read-Only:

- `else` (String) The key of the sequence to continue down when the condition is not met.
- `if` (Attributes) Conditions to test. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch--if))
- `then` (String) The key of the sequence to continue down when the condition is met.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch--if"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.branch.if`

Read-Only:

- `alert_properties` (List of Object) Test the alert property. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch--if--alert_properties))

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--branch--if--alert_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.branch.if.alert_properties`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the alert property.
- `value` (String) Value to match.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--delay"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.delay`

Read-Only:

- `delay_seconds` (Number) How long to delay in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--escalation_path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.escalation_path`

Read-Only:

- `escalation_path_id` (String) The ID of the escalation path to reassign to.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--level"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.level`

Read-Only:

- `targets` (List of Object) The targets to page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--level--targets))
- `time_to_ack_seconds` (Number) The time in seconds to wait for acknowledgement before escalating.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--level--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.level.targets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the target (user or schedule).
- `schedule_mode` (String) How to pick a target from the schedule.
- `selected_rota_id` (String) The ID of the selected rotation.
- `type` (String) The type of target (user or schedule).
- `urgency` (String) The urgency of the page (high or low).

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--loop"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.loop`

Read-Only:

- `back_to` (String) The `id` of the node to repeat from.
- `times` (Number) The number of times to repeat.

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--notify_channel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.notify_channel`

Read-Only:

- `targets` (List of Object) The channels to notify. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequences--nodes--notify_channel--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--sequences--nodes--notify_channel--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequences.nodes.notify_channel.targets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the channel.
- `type` (String) The type of channel (slack_channel or microsoft_teams_channel).

<a id="nestedatt--working_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `working_hours`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the working hours configuration.
- `name` (String) The name of the working hours configuration.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone of the working hours configuration.
- `weekday_intervals` (List of Object) The weekday intervals for the working hours. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--working_hours--weekday_intervals))

<a id="nestedatt--working_hours--weekday_intervals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `working_hours.weekday_intervals`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (String) The end time of the interval.
- `start_time` (String) The start time of the interval.
- `weekday` (String) The weekday of the interval.
